items.reason: app.js 把 after 与当前节点松散合并，缺失项继承旧值，且把审批状态写成节点实现状态；Reader 已有字段 diff 能力，却没有完整的节点数据来源。
items.risk: 旧节点来源混入新版；文件差异只能在底部读清单；新增/移除属性无法显示；与现有导航和 Reader 动画冲突。
checks: Before/After 两侧均显示各自完整快照；改/增/删文件逐条展示
变更字段显著标记、未变字段可折叠，删除字段不会从旧值偷偷恢复
文件位置、所属模块、操作类型、状态、证据和关联使用原 Reader 栏目而非长篇说明
Reason/Risk/Checks 留在独立的审阅元信息，默认简短，不写入 after.description
Human Check 审批颜色与节点实现状态严格分离
保留 Graph/Standard/Reader 三态、四箭头、双语和现有按节点审批行为

after.description: 目标：从 Work Plan 预审、节点与文件授权、任务实施到独立结果审计和人类决定，保持各阶段的证据与权限边界；普通 Agent 不得修改 Core 与 Harness 治理。

items.reason: ATLAS_AUTHORING_STANDARD 已区分 title/summary/description/evidence/source，但 Human Check 缺少完整的结构化审阅合同和字段层面反例。
items.risk: 审批仅检验表面文案；新的字段不被校验；审批后将计划性语言发布为事实；测试只验证按钮而未验证变更语义。
checks: 禁止以一大段说明替代输入/输出/关系/属性/文件/证据的变更
After 只能有节点可独立成立的陈述，禁止将「将/拟/修改为」等审阅叙述写成长期正文
审批前校验新旧快照、file_changes、source_refs 与授权路径的一致性
审批允许实施，不证明源码和科研结果；改动后用真实源码重新生成 Observed 并与 Proposed 比较
变更未声明文件、来源不符、旧证据残留、无变化的伪修改、英文缺失/乱码均提供负面测试
旧提案兼容只读，不自动转换或修改冻结的 7+5 条提案

items.reason: 现有 human_check.create() 使用 atlas.brief() 截取少数字段，且仅强制 after.title/description；无法确认属性和文件归属真正改变。
items.risk: 提案继承过期字段，未存在源码被写成证据；错误地扩展文件修改授权。
checks: 从各树实际权威来源取完整 Before，而不是 brief 截断
After 是完整、独立、可以作为节点阅读的结构化状态；未指定字段不得隐式回退
非编辑类变更可只改文案；功能/文件/关系变更必须在对应类型字段体现
精确文件操作、前后身份、所属职责与受影响节点字段可逐项审批
未存在的拟议文件不得被伪称为已实现证据
稳定节点 ID 语义变化须显式申请迁移而不是偷偷改定义

contract.principle: The node is a structured, self-contained record; review is a separate action-specific record. Do not encode the change request in node.description.
contract.note: Per-tree adapters only emit fields genuinely applicable to a source node. Source/Code fields from AST stay read-only until implementation; no fake performance proof.

snapshot_schema.field_changes: typed list with canonical field path + before/after values
snapshot_schema.file_changes: typed per-file add/change/remove/move with owner, role, source hashes and approval group
snapshot_schema.review_metadata: reason, risk, checks, authorization, not node body
snapshot_schema.observed_node: regenerated from actual source after implementation, never assumed from proposal
snapshot_schema.derived_fields: Actual implementation SHA, observed node status, runtime evidence, and last_change are only finalized after implementation; never blindly copied as new verification.

required_checks: source snapshot is pinned to exact SHA and authority file digest
after_node stands alone; no implicit old-field fallback
semantic edits change corresponding typed fields; pure wording edits declared editorial
new/removed files and refs have exact roles; missing paths flagged planned not evidence
node status remains independent of review decision
evidence and status need actual source to advance
reject stale or undeclared files; retain original reviewed records as immutable
unchanged data preserved explicitly and compared for source drift
historical last_change may be retained as history, but new revision metadata is written only after observed implementation and approval
every allowed source path has a structured file_changes record with its owner, existing blob identity and exact operation; unlisted paths are denied

presentation.graph: title and short summary of the proposed node, not approval instructions
presentation.reader: Before/After whole nodes, side-by-side field diffs; typed file changes in Sources/Implementation; role/status and evidence in own sections
presentation.review_footer: minimal reason, risk and acceptance only; do not inject metadata into node body

contract.language_policy: Every authored node must read correctly once the proposal becomes a real node. No '拟新增/将修改' in title/summary/description; planned state lives in review metadata and source status.
contract.legacy_compatibility: Old v1 proposals remain immutable/read-only; no auto-migration of any currently frozen reviews.

delivery.canonical_ledger: experiment/_human_check/<HC-ID>/review.json — sealed, authoritative plan: complete before/after snapshots, field_changes, file_changes, decisions
delivery.rendered_report: experiment/_human_check/<HC-ID>/report.md — derived digest of field and file changes; review metadata is separate
delivery.public_preview: harness/visualization/review-proposals/<HC-ID>.json — source-backed, read-only browser preview; no authenticated decisions
delivery.post_edit_evidence: experiment/_human_check/<HC-ID>/observed.json — actual file/AST/graph after implementation and Proposed-vs-Observed reconciliation
delivery.no_parallel_truth: All views are derived from sealed review.json and actual post-edit source; do not maintain competing manual node descriptions.

lifecycle: Read authoritative source for each tree at exact SHA; capture complete before_node and associated file identities.
Author a complete independent after_node in established source fields; record explicit planned file and relation changes separately.
Compute typed per-field add/remove/change/unchanged, reject stale or semantically empty changes, validate source and permission scopes.
Render graph/Reader using new-node content only; display old/new source files, identities, attributes and relations in structured sections.
Human approves specific nodes and file scopes, not a description of intentions; unchanged/unapproved scopes remain untouched.
After authorized edits, rebuild actual AST/graphs, derive observed_node, compare with approved after_node; report deviations for new review.
Update actual source-authority nodes and factual provenance only after validation; never auto-green science or copy old last_change as new evidence.
minimum_negative_tests: Functional change modifies only description without changing any relevant structured information
After omits a former field but legacy renderer reintroduces it from Before
Before contains attributes or file references absent from snapshot
Proposed file is absent from file_changes or outside authorized scope
Proposed new file is displayed as implemented source
Approval state overwrites node's actual implementation/scientific status
Old source SHA or authority snapshot has changed
Source file moved but node path/evidence/Code references still point to old path
Approval claims a change whose after_node is identical to before_node
Change alters stable node meaning without new node identity or migration proposal
English tree fields missing or fallback copy is misreported as translated
